summary: Shoshone County, ID Coeur d'Alene NF lookout: 50-ft L-4 cabin tower c.1928, trailer by 1967, gone by 1969. No source describes the site today.

corrections.why: All three sources give only the 1969 end date, and say gone. None says the lookout was abandoned.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com's header reads R.I.P. 1928-1967, but its text gives the 1967 trailer and Gone 1969, and Idaho Fire Lookouts and Forest Lookouts both give 1969. The story treats 1967 as the year the trailer appears and 1969 as the year the site is gone.

notes_for_editor: Do not confuse with the other Beaver Peak in Shoshone County, on the St. Joe National Forest (T43N R8E sec. 23, 3 miles west of Red Ives RS, destroyed 1953; firelookout.org lists it at 47.05694, -115.42511). That one is at idaholookouts.weebly.com/beaver-peak1.html and firelookout.com/id/beaverpeak267.html. The brief record (47.9872, -116.17042, Coeur d'Alene NF) matches the sources used here. Unverified lead, from a search snippet only, not read and not linked to this lookout: a Forest Lookouts Shoshone County page mentions a December 1928 lightning death of a Coeur d'Alene TPA lookout, Clair Corey, on an unnamed mountain. No source describes the site today or its access. No source calls the 1928 tower the first lookout, so the story does not say so.
